RoomSense: tests

What the automatic tests check, suite by suite. How to build and run them: BUILD.md §3; overview in DOCUMENTATION.md §17.

LevelWhereNeedsSize
Unit teststests/, one binary tests/testsnothing: no BLE, broker, network or display16 suites, about 120 test functions
End to endtools/e2e.sha desktop build of AcquaThermoNet and its repository (simulators), unshare35 checks, about 2 min
Real brokertools/broker_check.shthe broker credentialstest zones only

Run the unit tests and the end-to-end test after every change to the code; add a unit test with every change of bleparse.cpp, configfile.cpp, mqtt.cpp or zonecontrol.cpp.

1. How the unit tests work

  • QtTest, one class per suite (tests/tst_<name>.cpp), all run in order by tests/main.cpp, with the offscreen platform unless QT_QPA_PLATFORM is set; the last line says OK or FAIL and the number of failed test functions.
  • No real files: every test writes its setting.ini in a QTemporaryDir.
  • No BLE: BleParse gets hand-made HCI events; the readings for Mqtt are built in the test; FakeScenario is tested on its own.
  • An in-process MQTT broker (tests/fakebroker.h): records CONNECT (client id, keepalive, Will), PUBLISH and SUBSCRIBE, acknowledges QoS 1, delivers messages to the subscribers as AcquaThermoNet would, keeps the retained ones, can be stopped and started again.
  • No waiting: ages and timeouts run on MonoClock, moved with MonoClock::advanceForTest(); the collected presses and confirmation timeouts of ZoneControl are shortened (50 ms, 300 ms).
  • Widgets (main page, diagnostic page, screen saver, main window) are built with a ZoneControl fed by hand and checked through their child widgets (objectName) and simulated mouse clicks.

3. End to end: tools/e2e.sh

tools/e2e.sh <RoomSense> <AcquaThermoNet> <HA_Hmi_Relay dir>

Both real applications (desktop builds, offscreen), the AcquaThermoNet simulators (tools/minibroker.py on port 18830, tools/mbsim.py), in a network namespace of their own (unshare -rn): the single instance locks are per namespace, so instances the user runs are not disturbed, and no real broker is reachable. AcquaThermoNet: zones salotto and camera at 20 °C, sensor timeout 15 s, frost protection and valve exercise off. RoomSense: the two sensors, generated readings with RS_FAKE events.

PhaseStimulusChecks
1. RoomSense publishesstart; a spike (+8 °C) at 20 s and an 85 °C reading at 24 s on salottoclient id, RoomSense/status online retained, AcquaThermoNet sees RoomSense online; the first reading waits for confirmation; readings as JSON numbers with the MAC, not retained, no Invalid sensor data at AcquaThermoNet; the spike waits for confirmation and the 85 °C is dropped, neither published
2. RoomSense stoppedSIGTERMexit code 0, RoomSense/status offline, AcquaThermoNet sees RoomSense offline; both sensors lost, zones off
3. Back, panel commandsrestart; camera lost while running; +2 on salotto; windows open, normal, boost, normal from the house popupsensors back; one set_temp 21, not retained, confirmed by state_temp 21; mode/set window, not retained, mode/state with countdown, salotto at 8, RoomSense shows the mode; normal: salotto back to 21; boost: salotto at 25, countdown; camera lost while RoomSense runs, salotto still heard; AcquaThermoNet saved 21
4. EndSIGTERM to bothAcquaThermoNet exit code 0

On failure the script prints the tail of the broker log and both application logs.

4. Real broker: tools/broker_check.sh

MQTT_PASSWORD=... tools/broker_check.sh <RoomSense> <host> <port> <user>

A smoke test against the real broker: RoomSense with generated readings on the test zones e2e_test_1 and e2e_test_2, which no AcquaThermoNet knows (the heating is not affected); the read-only subscriber tools/mqttsub.py checks what the broker delivers. The only visible effect is RoomSense/status going online, then offline. The password comes from the environment, never from the command line.

5. Not covered automatically

To check by hand, on the desktop or on the house panel:

  • the real BLE scan (HCI socket, adapter retries, the Bluetooth reset of start.sh) and the real sensors;
  • the look of the pages (sizes, touch, scrolling): a scratch program that builds a page with fake data and saves widget->grab();
  • network services: met.no / wttr.in, the webcam URL;
  • the panel: libQt5Svg, JPEG plugin, watchdog, launcher install and update, boot splash.

6. Adding a test

  • A new case: a private slot in tests/tst_<name>.cpp (_data() for a table of cases).
  • A new suite: tests/tst_<name>.cpp with run<Name>Tests(), added to tests/tests.pro (with the sources it needs) and called in tests/main.cpp (before runLoggingTests, which must stay last).
  • A new check with AcquaThermoNet: an RS_FAKE event (fakescenario.*) and a check in tools/e2e.sh.
  • Then update this document.
